serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-server-auditor
serverInfo.description: MCP server that audits other MCP servers' tool definitions for insecure patterns — excessive-agency tool names, shell/eval/SQL/SSRF sinks fed by raw tool input, overly permissive schemas, hardcoded secrets, and wildcard CORS

tools.name: scan_text
tools.description: Scan a text string or code snippet for insecure MCP server/tool-definition patterns (excessive-agency tool names, shell/eval/SQL/SSRF sinks fed by raw tool input, overly permissive schemas, hardcoded secrets, wildcard CORS).

label.description: Optional label shown in findings (e.g. filename)

tools.name: scan_file
tools.description: Scan a single file for insecure MCP server/tool-definition patterns

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to scan

tools.name: scan_directory
tools.description: Recursively scan an MCP server's codebase for insecure tool-definition patterns. Automatically skips node_modules, .git, dist, and binary files.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory to scan

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to scan (default: 5000)

include.description: Only scan files whose path contains one of these strings

exclude.description: Skip files/dirs whose path contains one of these strings

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: List all MCP server security patterns that the auditor can detect, grouped by category
